description:
Externalize model-routing doctrine from Clavain prose into policy-as-data consumed by 'ic route' in intercore. Generalizes internal/routing past the Claude-only ModelTier enum to a deployment-keyed capability-vector registry (vendor/model@deployment), roles-not-model-names policy (routing.yaml), trust-zone constraints, cross-harness adapter contract (Clavain, Codex, Hermes Agent pilot on zklw), interspect feedback loop.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-07-13-model-routing-externalization.md
Reviews: docs/research/flux-melange/model-routing-externalization-plan/ (melange 4-round + fd-architecture seam pass; 18+ findings folded, each tagged).
Branch: mk/model-routing-externalization

7 phases: (1) contract spec, (2) mechanism generalization incl. PolicyHash reconciliation + 3-orderings inventory (P0: escalate.go ladder is Claude-only and doesn't import routing), (3) ic route CLI, (4) harness adapters + conformance bar, (5) interspect feedback + F3/F4 canary, (6) interrank facts refresh, (7) Hermes-on-zklw pilot.

Verdict: intercore-not-new-repo holds (routing is the other half of the dispatch/escalate decision intercore already owns). Seam adversarially validated.
title: Externalize model routing: cross-vendor registry + ic route CLI
